facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog defines data orchestration in marketing personalization as the combination of data, identity and artificial intelligence.
facts.quote: Simply put, data orchestration in marketing personalization is the combination of data, identity and artificial intelligence.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'Why data orchestration is key to marketing personalization' was published on 2020-04-09.
StackAdapt advises marketers that all third-party data providers use different methodologies, with some better than others, so buyers should ask how the data is collected and modelled.
facts.quote: all 3rd-party data providers will have different methodologies (some better than others).

facts.fact: StackAdapt's B2C movie example recommends bidding on a CPCV goal to retarget users who watched the entire trailer with native or display ads promoting ticket sales.
facts.quote: Use bidding based on a CPCV goal to retarget the people who watched the entire trailer with a native or display ad, promoting a ticket sale

facts.fact: StackAdapt notes that B2B marketers often invest heavily in the lower funnel, which it says bottlenecks their ability to convert people.
facts.quote: Often B2B marketers invest heavily in the lower funnel. However, this strategy actually bottlenecks their ability to convert people.
